candidates.researchQuestion: How should a forward-compatible agent API retire a field when silently ignoring that field would change the caller's authorization meaning?
candidates.title: Forward-Compatible APIs Still Need Selective Fail-Closed Boundaries
candidates.title_zh: 前向兼容 API 也需要有选择地失败关闭
candidates.coreProposition: Forward-compatible agent APIs should preserve general unknown-field tolerance while explicitly rejecting retired fields whose silent loss would change authorization or execution meaning.

sections.heading: One unknown-field rule can create opposite risks
sections.heading_zh: 同一个未知字段规则，可能产生两种相反风险

sections.heading: Targeted rejection preserves the general compatibility rule
sections.heading_zh: 定向拒绝保留了一般兼容规则

sections.heading: A retirement registry should describe meaning, not only versions
sections.heading_zh: 退役登记应描述语义，而不只是版本

sections.heading: The evidence does not establish end-to-end authorization safety
sections.heading_zh: 证据没有证明端到端授权安全

evidenceClaims.claim: The merged app-server change rejects permissionProfile before permissive deserialization on thread/start, thread/resume, thread/fork and turn/start.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已合并的 App-server 变更在宽松反序列化之前拒绝 thread/start、thread/resume、thread/fork 与 turn/start 上的 permissionProfile。

evidenceClaims.claim: Unrelated unknown fields remain accepted, named permissions remain usable, and repeated obsolete-field rejection does not poison the connection.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 无关未知字段仍被接受，命名 permissions 仍可使用，重复拒绝过时字段也不会破坏连接。

evidenceClaims.claim: The mechanism does not authenticate callers or approvers, establish policy provenance, or prove complete permission-path coverage and end-to-end authorization safety.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 该机制不会认证调用者或审批者，不建立策略来源，也不证明权限路径完整覆盖与端到端授权安全。

evidenceClaims.claim: Structural schema compatibility and authorization-semantic compatibility should be governed as separate decisions.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 结构 Schema 兼容与授权语义兼容应作为两个独立决定进行治理。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general agent API compatibility and authorization semantics; no first-party project is required.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already addresses the transferable API-governance problem and no separate community angle adds sufficient value.

candidates.researchQuestion: When a durable agent can select different execution environments across turns, which object should own the policy that controls process-environment inheritance and explicit variables?
candidates.title: Execution Environments Should Own Their Configuration Policy
candidates.title_zh: 执行环境应拥有自己的配置策略
candidates.coreProposition: Execution-scoped configuration should follow the resolved environment that owns the work, with explicit fallback and precedence plus a stable policy identity for durable resume.

sections.heading: Environment selection is incomplete without policy selection
sections.heading_zh: 环境选择如果不包含策略选择，就不是完整选择

sections.heading: Fallback and precedence must be part of the contract
sections.heading_zh: Fallback 与 Precedence 必须成为合同

sections.heading: Durable work also needs policy identity
sections.heading_zh: 持久任务还需要 Policy Identity

sections.heading: Debug redaction is not a confidentiality guarantee
sections.heading_zh: Debug 脱敏不是保密保证

evidenceClaims.claim: EnvironmentConfig carries ShellEnvironmentPolicy and redacts it from Debug output because it may contain explicit variable values.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: EnvironmentConfig 携带 ShellEnvironmentPolicy，并因其可能含显式变量值而在 Debug 输出中脱敏。

evidenceClaims.claim: Regular shell, user-shell and unified-exec consume the selected turn environment policy, with a session-derived inferred configuration as fallback.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 普通 Shell、User-shell 与 Unified-exec 消费已选择 Turn Environment 的策略，并以 Session 推导配置作为回退。

evidenceClaims.claim: Conflicting-policy regression tests show selected-environment filtering wins while environment-owned explicit values survive.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 冲突策略回归测试表明，已选择环境的过滤规则生效，同时环境拥有的显式值被保留。

evidenceClaims.claim: The implementation does not establish complete process isolation, universal subprocess coverage, or secret non-disclosure.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 该实现不建立完整进程隔离、所有子进程路径覆盖或 Secret 不泄露。

evidenceClaims.claim: Execution context should be governed as a configuration-authority boundary, with policy identity added when durable resume can encounter semantic drift.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 执行上下文应作为配置权威边界治理；当持久恢复可能遇到语义漂移时，还应增加 Policy Identity。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion applies generally to runtimes with selectable execution environments and requires no first-party project example.

communityEdition.rationale: The Research Center edition already provides the complete mechanism, recovery consequence and confidentiality boundary.

candidates.researchQuestion: How can an agent runtime reduce command-noise in an operational UI without destroying the detailed execution evidence needed for inspection and replay?
candidates.title: Compact Operations Should Not Compress Away Execution Evidence
candidates.title_zh: 紧凑运维界面不应压缩掉执行证据
candidates.coreProposition: Operational compaction should be a bounded, replayable view transform over recoverable execution evidence, while formal auditability remains a separate durability and provenance contract.

sections.heading: Readability and evidence retention are independent axes
sections.heading_zh: 可读性与证据保留是两条独立轴

sections.heading: Some boundaries should resist a success summary
sections.heading_zh: 有些边界不应该被成功摘要吞没

sections.heading: Replay needs versioned presentation rules
sections.heading_zh: Replay 需要版本化展示规则

sections.heading: A transcript is not automatically an audit log
sections.heading_zh: Transcript 不是自动生成的审计日志

evidenceClaims.claim: The merged TUI groups only successful Agent and UnifiedExecStartup activity, caps a completed group at 32 calls, and flushes at failure, non-groupable and interaction-visible boundaries.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已合并 TUI 只聚合成功的 Agent 与 UnifiedExecStartup 活动，一个完成组最多 32 个调用，并在失败、不可分组与交互可见边界刷新。

evidenceClaims.claim: Compact display summaries coexist with transcript_lines that retain individual commands and output.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 紧凑显示摘要与保留逐条命令和输出的 transcript_lines 同时存在。

evidenceClaims.claim: Replay applies compatible grouping without duplicate command starts, while overlapping active work remains visible.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Replay 应用兼容分组且避免重复 Command Start，同时重叠活动工作保持可见。

evidenceClaims.claim: The demonstrated transcript is not a cryptographic or append-only audit log and does not prove durable persistence, provenance, or complete side-effect reconstruction.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已证明的 Transcript 不是密码学或 Append-only Audit Log，也不证明持久存储、Provenance 或完整副作用重建。

evidenceClaims.claim: Operational compaction is safest as a reversible view transform over a richer evidence model rather than destructive summarization of the authoritative record.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 运维压缩最适合作为富证据模型之上的可逆展示变换，而不是对权威记录的破坏性摘要。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general operational UI and evidence-model design for agent runtimes; no first-party project mapping is necessary.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already separates presentation, evidence and audit promises for the relevant engineering audience.
